question: Why does only form appear in pure form when similar shining occurs in eye, mirror, sky, and water?
premises: Similar shining occurs in eye, mirror, sky, and water.
In pure form, form alone appears.
The verse emphasizes this with indeed.
inference: Pure form reveals form alone, unlike mixed media where similar shining occurs.
uncertainties: sadṛśaṃ may modify shining or form.
plain_english: Similar shining appears in eye, mirror, sky, and water; indeed, in pure form only form appears.
